reason: The first frozen selector chose native J throughout discovery. Before any reserved producer is compiled, test a directly scoped option that can preserve useful partitioning of the main graph. Keep the first frozen study intact.
scope: Public source-level implementation in stock jaxlib 0.9.0.1. Compile the original main-only graph with default XLA. Independently compile only the observer closure on the original inputs and weights, then return both outputs. Producers may be recomputed, the two executables can incur extra calls, and the selected build must pay for both. Omit the main call only when the main result is the identical input by the declared source contract.
controls: split_on vs split_off holds graph boundaries, main binary and number of dispatches fixed. Native and whole_off preserve their original single-executable interface. Separate is a native single-module alternative. Blocks await all output leaves.
cases: Use the same 11 development graphs and then the same 4 new held-out structures at two sizes and three resource settings. Collect independent timing cohorts for this panel. No held-out structure is compiled in either panel before this additional selector is frozen.
timing: Reuse the partition-boundary 5 processes, 3 input seeds, 4 warm and 12 timed rounds and three same-executable aliases in randomized complete blocks. Record actual decisions, trace+lower+compile for the selected set, individual artifact identities and raw checks.
policy: Fit a resource-only lookup and a scalar work-per-allowed-CPU stump with fixed native, split_off and separate as strong baselines. The same three options are available to a two-feature rows/CPU then work/CPU rule. Partition-neutral split_on and global-off are diagnostics only. Use the same power-of-two grid, minimum two training cells, all-output eligibility, N=1000 total-cost training objective and tie handling as the first frozen rule. Charge both builds even for the native main already available within the experiment, except the declared identity main which has no executable. All latency figures include dispatches and synchronization.
gate: Compare each policy against fixed native, fixed split_off, fixed separate, resource-only and grain-only at N=1,100,1000,10000. Require at least 5% lower paired geometric mean total cost than the best of these at N=1000, zero resolved default-affinity native latency harms and valid chosen results in every held-out cell. Register relative to the original gate as a separate follow-up. Do not substitute a winning endpoint between panels.
